summary: First Merchants Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 8.01 disclosing a quarterly cash dividend declaration by its board. The registrant declared $46.88 per share on its 7.50% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock Series A, equivalent to $0.4688 per depositary share (each a 1/100th interest). The dividend is payable November 16, 2026, to holders of record on October 30, 2026. No advisors, premium, stake, or strategic transaction terms were stated. This is an ordinary capital-return event, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply beyond routine preferred dividend coverage and accrual.
